write_up: It's common for freelance work to be described as a list of services, but your current role doesn't yet say how much work you did or what changed. Your earlier roles at Velocity Software and Bridgepoint Analytics point toward marketing management, and that's the job I read your resume for. A recruiter may finish the resume but hesitate over what you've been doing most recently.

The MQL line at Velocity is your best model: it gives a year-over-year increase and says cost per lead went down too. Your team of 4 marketers and $1.8M annual budget also make your management remit easy to understand. The summary could put that concrete work ahead of the generic claims.

Let's start with the freelance role. Add one or two projects, your part in each, and any results you can substantiate. Then give the ABM program and Bridgepoint work a little more detail so the earlier results don't have to carry the whole story.
